title.narrative: Solar Systems for Rural Health Facilities in Papua New Guinea

description.narrative: Outcome: Enhanced quality health services provided to communities in rural areas through utilizing freely available solar energy. Output 1: Pre-feasibility study delivered

This project idea aims at conducting pre-feasibility studies at selected sites as sample cases (at least 5 sites) to investigate and design off-grid, low maintenance, and viable solar power systems for up to 500 rural health facilities in PNG and to design a project to electrify the health care centers using solar power. As part of project scope, the ultimate goal is to identify and establish the most appropriate sustainable and reliable business model to mobilize the total estimated investment potential of USD 75M.
